notes.title: JUMP DLC RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]HOW BEAUTIFUL, FINALLY![/b]
JUMP DLC IS FINALLY READY AND CAN BE ACCESSED FROM 02/26/2025!!
It can be accessed through the game's main menu or by interacting with the cave, in WaterVille!

notes.title: D + L + C =... DLC????
notes.content:
Well folks, as you may have already read in the title of this announcement, the following will soon be released:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719750/77c73a6c6984b8847a14f89177b4ba968b228b42.png[/img]


I, Coronho, am very happy to announce the continuation of this project that I love doing so much and completes me so much as a human being!
In this new DLC update ([b]Downloadable Content[/b]) there will be new stages, music and mechanics! [i]LOTS OF NEW THINGS HEINNNN!!!![/i]


The cave found in WaterVille, with the mermaid at the door, will be the gateway to the DLC, being extra content and not necessary to complete the game. The update is free, as is the game to make it as accessible as possible. [b]EVERYONE MUST JUMPARRRRR[/b]

Well, I'm EXTREMELY excited for this update to be released and I hope you enjoy it too!! I will bring more information soon!!

For more information, follow the game here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2314270/Jump_By_Coronho_Chapter_2/]Steam[/url], on [url=https://twitter.com/JCoronho]Twitter (X)[/url] and/or [url=https://www.instagram.com/jumpthegame/]Instagram[/url]!

Hugs from your brother Coronho 😉👊!

notes.title: KEEP ON JUMPING!
notes.content:
Finally, Jump By Coronho Chapter 2 will officially see the sunlight!

So after a long time working on this game, I'm releasing it on Steam!!!! Launch will be Monday, the 13/03th at 13:00! It is the continuation of Jump By Coronho and has new mechanics, such as building and grappling. The game is free! Hope you like it!
For feedback and bug reports, just send an email to olivrolegal@gmail.com!

The saga continues. The universe of Jump By Coronho is expanded with new characters, mechanics and stories in Jump: Chapter 2. Throughout the gameplay, the player collects items and skills that help him in the experience, such as the hook and the ability to build.
